intent: Three new transparent motion materials based on current mascot; original image unchanged

prompts.body: Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction. Asset type: body material for a 2D mesh avatar, a single transparent RGBA PNG. EDIT the referenced pancake mascot. Keep this exact full-body character identity, stack silhouette, chocolate spots, nose, eyebrows, red scarf, blue hands and boots, both raised arms, glossy warm cartoon shading and front-facing pose. Remove the entire beige background and ground shadow to genuine alpha transparency. Remove BOTH EYES including white eyeballs, pupils and eyelid outlines, and remove the mouth including teeth, dark interior, tongue and smile lines; reconstruct smooth uninterrupted golden pancake skin in precisely those face regions. Keep the small brown nose and the eyebrows. The result must have NO eye or mouth artwork anywhere because separate animated materials will supply them. Full character centered and wholly visible, same proportions and original relative feature positions. Square 1024x1024 transparent canvas, character fills approximately original framing with at least 35px transparent margin. No new butter, no new accessories, no text, no sheet, no background, no floor. This is a clean faceless body layer, not a completed avatar.
prompts.eyes: Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction. Asset type: paired eyes material for the referenced 2D pancake avatar. Return ONE genuine transparent RGBA PNG containing ONLY this exact character's TWO LARGE OPEN EYES as a pair: outer brown eyelid outlines, white sclera, blue irises, dark pupils and original bright highlights. Keep the original eye shapes, asymmetric perspective, size ratio and spacing. Remove all other artwork: no eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin, scarf, body, hands, feet, background, shadow or face-colored rectangle. Place the isolated eye pair centered on a wide horizontal transparent canvas with generous alpha margin; preserve both eyes' relative positions and make high-quality clean antialiased edges. No closed-eye variants, no text, no labels, no contact sheet. The eyes will be placed on a separately prepared clean body; no pancake skin may remain between or around the eyes.
prompts.mouth: Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction. Asset type: open mouth material for the referenced 2D pancake avatar. Return ONE genuine transparent RGBA PNG containing ONLY the exact mascot's smiling OPEN MOUTH: dark brown smile outline and interior, upper white teeth, warm pink tongue, cheerful wide curved silhouette. Keep the identity and glossy warm cartoon shading of the reference. Remove all other artwork: no eyes, eyebrows, nose, cheeks, face-colored rectangle, pancake body, scarf, hands, feet, floor, background or shadow. Isolated centered mouth on a wide horizontal transparent canvas with generous alpha margin and clean antialiased edges. No variants, no text, no labels, no sheet. This material will be mesh-scaled from a small smile to the full open smile.
